items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it was Ernie Farrell on bass... It was 1955 on Savoy Records.

ctx.x: Well, what did, what did you find uh flute brought to your uh your arsenal, for want of a better word?

Well, the, the reason I appreciated playing the flute is because after I made my first personal recording in ’55, I realized that, if I should continue to record, that I would have the vary of the canvas of my expression. So, being able to play flute helped me do that, and the oboe, of course, then I started looking, started studying music of other cultures. I wasn’t able to travel abroad, but I could go to the library and study scores and records, and I, I did as much of that as I could. Um and then I found like…
